mapper.sql: CLUB.CLUB_NUMB , CLUB.OWNR_NUMB , OWNER.USER_NICK AS OWNR_NICK , CLUB.CLUB_NAME , CLUB.CLUB_CNTN , CLUB.CLUB_VISB , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('CLUB_VISB', CLUB.CLUB_VISB, NULL, 'ko') AS CLUB_VISB_NAME , CLUB.JOIN_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('CLUB_JOIN', CLUB.JOIN_TYPE, NULL, 'ko') AS JOIN_TYPE_NAME , CLUB.CLUB_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('CLUB_STAT', CLUB.CLUB_STAT, NULL, 'ko') AS CLUB_STAT_NAME , CLUB.RCRT_YSNO , CLUB.MAXX_MEMB , COALESCE(SEAT.MEMBER_CNT, 0) AS MEMBER_CNT , COALESCE(SEAT.INVITED_CNT, 0) AS INVITED_CNT , CATE.CATEGORY_NAMES , CLUB.REGI_DATE , CLUB.UPDT_DATE , CLUB.CLOS_DATE

LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM OWNER ON OWNER.USER_NUMB = CLUB.OWNR_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , SUM(CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS MEMBER_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'INVITED' AND MEMBER.EXPR_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INVITED_CNT FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER GROUP BY MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB ) SEAT ON SEAT.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CLUB_CATE.CLUB_NUMB , GROUP_CONCAT(FN_GET_CODE_NAME('CATE_CODE', CLUB_CATE.INTR_CODE, NULL, 'ko') ORDER BY CLUB_CATE.SORT_ORDR SEPARATOR ', ') AS CATEGORY_NAMES FROM TB_CLCATE CLUB_CATE GROUP BY CLUB_CATE.CLUB_NUMB ) CATE ON CATE.CLUB_NUMB = CLUB.CLUB_NUMB

where.if: AND (CAST(CLUB.CLUB_NUMB AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CLUB.CLUB_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR OWNER.USER_NICK LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT /* getClubList */ PAGE.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CLUB.REGI_DATE DESC, CLUB.CLUB_NUMB DESC) AS ROW_NUMB , FROM TM_CLUBXM CLUB
) PAGE WHERE PAGE.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY PAGE.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getClubCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TM_CLUBXM CLUB
SELECT /* getClubForUpdate */ CLUB.CLUB_NUMB , CLUB.CLUB_STAT , CLUB.RCRT_YSNO FROM TM_CLUBXM CLUB WHERE CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: ACTION.CLUB_NUMB , ACTION.HIST_NUMB , ACTION.ADMN_NUMB , ADMINX.ADMN_NAME , ACTION.ACTN_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('CLAD_ACTN', ACTION.ACTN_TYPE, NULL, 'ko') AS ACTN_TYPE_NAME , ACTION.BEFR_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('CLUB_STAT', ACTION.BEFR_STAT, NULL, 'ko') AS BEFR_STAT_NAME , ACTION.AFTR_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('CLUB_STAT', ACTION.AFTR_STAT, NULL, 'ko') AS AFTR_STAT_NAME , ACTION.ACTN_RSON , ACTION.REGI_DATE
JOIN TM_ADMINX ADMINX ON ADMINX.ADMN_NUMB = ACTION.ADMN_NUMB
mapper.select: SELECT /* getLatestAction */ ACTION.CLUB_NUMB , ACTION.HIST_NUMB , ACTION.ACTN_TYPE , ACTION.BEFR_STAT , ACTION.AFTR_STAT FROM TH_CLADMN ACTION WHERE ACTION.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} ORDER BY ACTION.HIST_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT /* getActionCnt */ COUNT(*) FROM TH_CLADMN WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptRecruitStopped */ TM_CLUBXM SET RCRT_YSNO = 'N' , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND CLUB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND RCRT_YSNO = 'Y'
UPDATE /* uptClubSuspended */ TM_CLUBXM SET CLUB_STAT = 'PAUSED' , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND CLUB_STAT = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE /* uptClubRestored */ TM_CLUBXM SET CLUB_STAT = 'ACTIVE' , RCRT_YSNO = 'Y' , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , CLOS_DATE = NULL WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb}

UPDATE /* uptClubClosed */ TM_CLUBXM SET CLUB_STAT = 'CLOSED' , RCRT_YSNO = 'N' , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , CLOS_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND CLUB_STAT <> 'CLOSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT /* setActionNotifications */ INTO TB_ALIMXX ( USER_NUMB , ALIM_NUMB , ALIM_SITU , TEMP_CODE , ALIM_TITL , ALIM_CONT , TAGT_TYPE , TAGT_NUMB , REPL_NUMB , READ_YSNO , READ_DATE , SEND_DATE , DELT_YSNO ) SELECT MEMBER.USER_NUMB , COALESCE(ALIM.MAX_ALIM_NUMB, 0) + 1 , NULL , NULL , '독서 모임 운영 안내' , CASE #{actnType} WHEN 'RECRUIT_STOP' THEN CONCAT(CLUB.CLUB_NAME, ' 모임의 신규 모집이 중지되었습니다.') WHEN 'SUSPEND' THEN CONCAT(CLUB.CLUB_NAME, ' 모임의 이용이 일시 중지되었습니다.') WHEN 'RESTORE' THEN CONCAT(CLUB.CLUB_NAME, ' 모임의 운영 제한이 해제되었습니다.') WHEN 'CLOSE' THEN CONCAT(CLUB.CLUB_NAME, ' 모임의 운영이 종료되었습니다.') END , 'READING_CLUB' , MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB , NULL , 'N' , NULL , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , 'N' FROM TB_CLMEMX MEMBER JOIN TM_CLUBXM CLUB ON CLUB.CLUB_NUMB = MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB AND USERX.USER_STAT = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_NUMB , MAX(ALIM_NUMB) AS MAX_ALIM_NUMB FROM TB_ALIMXX GROUP BY USER_NUMB ) ALIM ON ALIM.USER_NUMB = MEMBER.USER_NUMB WHERE MEMBER.CLUB_NUMB = #{clubNumb} AND MEMBER.MEMB_STAT = 'ACTIVE'
